ideas.idea: Add booking instructions, dates or a server-rendered booking link on classes page
ideas.why: classes.html says to book early but offers no way to book, so a concrete content gap.

ideas.idea: Add ordering route, collection address and times to the home page
ideas.why: index.html mentions pre-order for weekend collection with no details on how or where.

ideas.idea: Link each major loaf to ingredients, availability and allergen info on breads page
ideas.why: breads.html is a thin single paragraph with no per-loaf information to read or cite.

ideas.idea: Add business contact details (address, opening hours, contact method)
ideas.why: No page gives an address, hours or contact method for a local bakery, which is accurate and helpful.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph / Twitter social preview metadata
ideas.why: Accurate that it's missing, but it's standard advice for any site with modest effect.

ideas.why: True of the sitemap but a common, low-impact suggestion for any small site.
